findings.title: Await calendar/video cancellation work before completing the reschedule
findings.body: `forEach` discards the promises returned by its async callback. After the new `await getCalendar(...)`, this function proceeds to send the reschedule email and returns `true` while the integration module may still be loading and the old calendar/video event may not yet have been deleted. Rejections from either the import or deletion also bypass the surrounding `try/catch` and become unhandled. Collect these operations with `Promise.all`/`Promise.allSettled` and await them so failed or delayed external cancellations are handled deterministically.

findings.title: Await calendar/video cancellation work before completing the reschedule
findings.body: `forEach` ignores the async callback promises. The added `await getCalendar(...)` means cancellation is deferred beyond this block, so the function can send the reschedule email and report success before the previous calendar or video event is removed. Any module-load or deletion error is not caught by the enclosing `try/catch`, because it occurs in the detached callback. Use an awaited `Promise.all`/`Promise.allSettled` over the references instead.

findings.title: Recurring calendar deletions are detached from the cancellation request
findings.body: The async `forEach` callbacks are never awaited. Each callback now suspends at `await getCalendar`, while the handler continues and later snapshots `apiDeletes` in `Promise.all`; at that point the callbacks may not have added anything yet. Moreover, they add `deletedEvent` only after awaiting it, so `apiDeletes` cannot track the in-flight work. A recurring cancellation can therefore finish successfully while some or all external calendar events remain undeleted, and callback failures are unhandled. Await per-credential/per-booking deletion promises directly before completing the handler.

findings.title: Do not detach integration deletions in requestReschedule
findings.body: This `forEach(async ...)` is not awaited. With asynchronous app loading, the mutation continues to send email/webhooks and can resolve before `getCalendar` has loaded the integration or before `deleteEvent`/`deleteMeeting` has run. Errors from those operations are also unhandled. Build a promise list for the booking references and await it (or await `Promise.allSettled` if deletion failures should not fail the reschedule) before returning from the mutation.
